description: Core concepts in biology from cell theory to ecology

principles: All living organisms are made of cells
The cell is the basic unit of life
All cells arise from pre-existing cells
cell_theory.prokaryotes: Cells without a nucleus; bacteria and archaea
cell_theory.eukaryotes: Cells with a membrane-bound nucleus; plants, animals, fungi, protists

cell_organelles.mitochondria: Produces ATP via cellular respiration; powerhouse of the cell
cell_organelles.vacuole: Storage; central vacuole in plants maintains turgor pressure

dna_and_genetics.dna_structure: Double helix of nucleotides; bases pair A-T and G-C

rna_types.mRNA: Carries genetic info from DNA to ribosome

mendelian_genetics.dominant: Expressed when one or two copies of allele present
mendelian_genetics.recessive: Expressed only when two copies present
mendelian_genetics.law_of_segregation: Each organism carries two alleles for each trait, separated during gamete formation
mendelian_genetics.law_of_independent_assortment: Genes on different chromosomes sort independently

evolution.natural_selection: Organisms with favorable traits survive and reproduce more
evolution.mutation: Random changes in DNA sequence; source of genetic variation
evolution.speciation: Formation of new species through reproductive isolation
evolution.darwin: Proposed natural selection as mechanism of evolution in 'On the Origin of Species' (1859)

ecosystems.producers: Autotrophs that convert sunlight to energy (plants, algae)
ecosystems.decomposers: Break down dead organic matter (fungi, bacteria)
ecosystems.energy_flow: Only ~10% of energy transfers between trophic levels

human_body_systems.circulatory: Heart, blood vessels, blood; transports oxygen and nutrients
human_body_systems.respiratory: Lungs, airways; gas exchange (O₂ in, CO₂ out)
human_body_systems.digestive: Breaks down food into absorbable nutrients
human_body_systems.nervous: Brain, spinal cord, nerves; controls body functions
human_body_systems.endocrine: Glands and hormones; regulates metabolism and growth
human_body_systems.immune: Defends against pathogens via innate and adaptive immunity
human_body_systems.skeletal: 206 bones in adult humans; support and protection

photosynthesis.light_reactions: Occur in thylakoids; capture light energy to split water, produce ATP/NADPH
photosynthesis.calvin_cycle: Occurs in stroma; uses ATP/NADPH to fix CO₂ into glucose
